description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task. Use claude-code or codex for a worker backed by the corresponding local CLI.

model.description: Optional model to use for this agent. If not specified, inherits from parent. Prefer lighter models for quick, straightforward tasks to minimize cost and latency.

agent_id.description: Deploy an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Starts a new conversation with that agent.

conversation_id.description: Resume from an existing conversation. Does NOT require agent_id (conversation IDs are unique and encode the agent).

computer.description: Run the subagent on another connected computer instead of this machine. Prefer a stable device ID or computer name; ephemeral connection IDs are also supported to pin a specific listener. Pass "cloud" to provision a Cloud sandbox for the subagent's conversation. Fails fast if the device is offline or does not support routing. Omit this field to run on the current machine (the default) — only set it when the task specifically needs to run elsewhere.

mcp.description: For claude-code or codex, optionally expose discovery metadata for MCP servers available to the parent agent. This does not grant new authorization.

inherit.description: When true, inject MCP discovery metadata into the external coding agent.

servers.description: Optional exact subset of parent MCP server names to advertise. Requires inherit: true.
